provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF artifacts, GitHub read outputs summarized in provider read integration record, release docs, and runtime audits are canonical; chat text is not release evidence

event_summaries.summary: Heartbeat required AOF to use the latest runtime and AI development trends to continue the roadmap and release the nearest target.
AOF runtime visibility and release-state audit selected v11.2 as the next frontier after v11.1.
Read-only gh commands observed repository metadata, v11.1 release, open issues, open pull requests, and workflow runs.
Provider read integration schemas, audit command, command registry entries, release docs, and evidence artifacts were added.
provider-read-integration-audit passed for one live read integration with zero write attempts and zero write authorization.
Role outputs and Council review framed v11.2 as governed read-only provider integration proof, not write permission.
Provider read integration must not be misread as GitHub write execution, production safety, or provider semantic truth.
Stop release if v11.2 claims provider write authority, live automation, production safety, or semantic truth.

risk_candidates: provider read integration may be mistaken for provider write permission
decision_candidates: advance to v11.3 only after v11.2 proves governed read-only provider integration

redaction_boundary: summaries only; no secrets, credentials, private provider payload bodies, or private transcript content exported
release_ready_boundary: release-ready requires runtime audits, tests, smoke, and CI/tag validation, not this export alone
not_proven: Session export proves traceability for v11.2 release work only; it does not prove provider semantic truth, GitHub write safety, production safety, productivity gain, or adoption.
